description: Legal / statutory / regulatory domain relations, seeded from the closure test's legal-statute (real GDPR) + regulatory registers. The lean core already covered real statutory text at ~100% distinct; this pack names the deontic residue (obligation/prohibition/right/penalty/supersession) that a statute-heavy corpus benefits from.

obligates.description: a law, regulation, or clause obligates, requires, or mandates a party to act or comply

prohibits.description: a law or clause prohibits, forbids, bans, or restricts an action or party

grants_right.description: a law or authority grants, confers, or provides a right, permission, entitlement, or exemption to a party

penalizes.description: a law imposes a penalty, fine, sanction, or liability for a violation or breach

overrules_supersedes.description: a ruling, law, or authority overrules, repeals, amends, or supersedes another law, ruling, or provision
